scope: Exactly the six existing source interval-prefix patterns and newly eligible8/10texts:5378/8037starts perpattern,40245totalalignment scores. No other corpus/window/threshold.

independent_check: Reconstruct every integer alignment score; compare every saved float score and integer array; independently derive maxima, all integer tie offsets and chosen source raw-float offsets. Check original sorted-text and strict-greater source selection without forcing earliest integer tie.

fft_numerical_policy.selection: Raw float np.argmax gives first exact float tie; global source selects first sorted text unless a strictly larger raw float occurs. Numerical allowance validates counts only and never rounds scores or changes a winner.
fft_numerical_policy.report: Actual maximum FFT-vs-integer error; chosen offset membership in exact integer max set; earliest integer-max offset/tie count separately.

controls: Review frozen producer controls and verify independent direct counts of every retained synthetic score array before targets. Include first/final starts, exact-width and shorter-than-width carriers,120..399 carrier, and ties.
merge: Old84 receipt may be reused only with same raw input manifest and independently reconstructed exact obs/fcount hashes for each pattern. Reconstruct global strict raw-float comparisons and distinguish reused old rows from new rows.
interpretation: Counts are compatible word-length positions, not recovered words; two shuffles perprefix do not calibrate a global probability. This is not historical224corpus or all-subwindow coverage.
